status: one full reader pass plus a second pass on lines 1-11; no vote (about 0.88 per sign on known text for a single pass)

fields.voted: class after the vote of the passes (two of three; with two passes agreement; with one pass as read)
fields.votes: class -> number of passes that read it there ('nul' = a pass saw no sign there)
fields.tied_candidates: present where the passes did not agree: the classes the decoder could choose among
fields.final: class used in the decode ('nul' = left out); differs from 'voted' only at ties and at applied corrections
fields.letters: the letter(s) the key gives with the recorded choice ('' for code, ? and nul)
